selection: Complete frozen v5 groups; calibration only for saved temperature; fixed final step with no test/OOD selection
regression_controls: The same frozen 128 Test + 128 OOD v4 groups selected by the earlier continued-2B pilot; recompute both checkpoints in this runtime
ablation: Save baseline and trained logits; report both weight states at both original and calibration-fitted temperatures. Separate decision accuracy from probability and Noul threshold behavior.
stop_policy: One fixed run only. Preserve failures/negative results. No schedule, checkpoint or threshold retuning from test/OOD.
scope: Controlled original synthetic pilot. No public/sealed benchmark content, official JevBench improvement or deployment-ready model claim.
